NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

FEB 12 1930

Hongkew Celebrates
Empire Day

A festive spirit prevailed north of
Soochow Creek yesterday as Japanese
celebrated the 2596th anniversary of
the founding of the Japanese Empire,
the Shanghai "Shinichi" reported.
Hongkew streets were gaily bedeck-
ed with Rising Sun emblems, while
official ceremonies were carried on at
schools, the Japanese Consulate, and
the Shanghai Shrine.
Japanese civilians assembled at the
Japanese Central Primary School on
Range Road, at 9 a.m. and bowed in
silent homage toward the Imperial
Palace in Tokyo. Ceremonies in
which all present bowed to the Im-
perial Portraits were held at all
schools under the supervision of the
Japanese Residents' Corporation,
beginning at 8.30 a.m.
Mr. Yoshiaki Miura, Japanese Con-
sul General, led similar observances
at the Japanese Consulate-General,
where local Japanese officials and
civilian leaders gathered.
A brief special service was held
in the Shanghai Shrine at 10.30 a.m.,
followed by Shintoist ceremonies half
an hour later, the Japanese daily
stated.

《字林西报》，

1930年2月12日

虹口庆祝
帝国日

据上海《新日报》报道，昨日苏州河以北洋溢着节日气氛，日本人在此庆祝日本帝国建立2596周年。虹口的街道上装饰着旭日旗徽，而在学校、日本领事馆和上海神社则举行了官方仪式。
上午9时，日本平民聚集在靶子路（Range Road）的日本中央小学，向东京皇居方向静默致敬。在居留民团的监督下，所有学校于上午8时30分开始举行仪式，在场人员均向天皇御像鞠躬。
日本总领事三浦义明（Yoshiaki Miura）先生在日本总领事馆主持了类似的纪念活动，当地日本官员和民间领袖出席了该活动。
据该日文日报称，上午10时30分在上海神社举行了简短的特别祭祀，半小时后举行了神道教仪式。

S. 1. Special Branch, Smpol 7788
REPORT
Date February 12. 1938.

Subject The Ceremony of Japan's Empire Day.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by C. Crawford L. I.

Japan's Empire Day ceremony which took place at the
Shanghai Shrine on Kiangwan Road at 11 a.m. February 11 and
lasted for about forty minutes was attended by some 900
Japanese officials and civilians. Among those personages
were General I. Matsui, Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese
Forces in Central China; Rear-Admiral D. Ohkochi, Commander
of the Japanese Naval Landing Party; Rear-Admiral T. Honda,
Naval Attache; Mr. S. Okamoto, Consul-General; Mr. M. Amano,
President of the Japanese Residents' Corporation; and Mr. T.
Urabe, Japanese Member of the Municipal Council.
Precautionary measures were taken during the ceremony
by the staff of Dixwell Road Station, the Japanese Naval
Landing Party and the Japanese Gendarmerie but no untoward
incident occurred.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL am 3. 12 FEB. 1938 SPECIAL BRANCH）
D. Kamashita
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

报告
日期：1938年2月12日。

主题：日本帝国日仪式。

制作人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：C. Crawford L. I.

2月11日上午11时在江湾路上海神社举行的日本帝国日仪式持续了约四十分钟，约有900名日本官员和平民出席。出席的人物包括：华中日军司令官松井石根（I. Matsui）中将；日本海军陆战队指挥官大越（D. Ohkochi）少将；海军武官本多（T. Honda）少将；总领事冈本（S. Okamoto）先生；日本居留民团团长天野（M. Amano）先生；以及工部局董事会日籍董事浦边（T. Urabe）先生。
迪克斯韦尔路（Dixwell Road）巡捕房职员、日本海军陆战队和日本宪兵队在仪式期间采取了预防措施，但未发生任何意外事件。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局 1938年2月12日上午3时 特务科）
D. Kamashita
D. S.

副总监，特务科。

THE CEREMONY OF JAPAN'S EMPIRE DAY
Tomorrow, February 11, is the anniversary
of the accession of the Emperor Jimmu and is a national
holiday. From 11 a.m. a ceremony will be held at the
Shanghai Jinsha Shrine, Kiangwan Road.

日本帝国日仪式
明日，2月11日，是神武天皇即位纪念日，为国定假日。上午11时起，将在江湾路上海金沙神社举行仪式。

S.I. Special Branch / Station,
REPORT
Date February 12, 1937.

Subject Ceremony celebrating 2597th. Anniversary of the Accession to the
Throne of the Emperor Jimmu.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Payne D S I

The 2597th. Anniversary of the accession to the throne
of the Emperor Jimmu, first Japanese monarch, was celebrated
locally with a ceremony at the Shanghai Shrine which commenced
at 11 a.m. February 11, 1937.

Nothing of an untoward nature occurred during the ceremony
which concluded shortly before mid-day.

Members of the Special Branch and Dixwell Road Station
carried out observation duty in the vicinity of the Shrine
during the course of the proceedings. The following
detectives attended from the Special Branch:-

D.S. Pitts, D.S. Larby and D.S. Kamashita and
S.D. Havildar 102 and S.DC. 674.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).
（印：13 FEB. 1937）

日期：1937年2月12日。

主题：庆祝第一代天皇神武天皇即位2597周年仪式。

制作人：D.S. Pitts。 转呈人：J. Payne D S I

1937年2月11日上午11时，在上海神社举行了庆祝日本第一位君主神武天皇即位2597周年的本地仪式。

仪式在中午前不久结束，期间未发生任何意外性质的事件。

特务科和迪克斯韦尔路巡捕房的成员在仪式进行期间在神社附近执行观察任务。以下侦探来自特务科：

D.S. Pitts，D.S. Larby 和 D.S. Kamashita 以及
S.D. 哈维尔达（Havildar）102号和 S.DC. 674号。

FESTIVAL OF
NATIONAL
FOUNDATION
DAY AT JAP-
ANESE SHRINE.
Between 11.a.m. to 11.30.a.m. 11-2-37 at the Japanese
Shrine, Klangwan Road, a ceremony in connection with the
festival of National Foundation Day was held. Some 1,000
students representing various Japanese schools, Major General
Hta, Military Attache to the Japanese Embassy, Rear Admiral
Okawachi, Commander of the J.N.L.Party and other Japanese
notables attended. Japanese Consular Police were on duty
inside the Shrine.

S.I, Special Branch,
REPORT
Date February 8, 1937.

Subject Ceremony to be held at the Shanghai Shrine, Kiangwan Road,
by Japanese residents on February 11.

Made by D.S. Kamashita Forwarded by Ibayu D.S.I

The 2,597th Anniversary of the Accession of the Emperor
Jimmu, will fall on February 11, on which day local Japanese
schools maintained by the Japanese Residents Corporation,
Japanese Navy and Japanese Consulate-General will respectively
hold a ceremony offering congratulation to His Majesty during
the morning. In the Japanese Consulate the ceremony will be
held by members of the Consulate between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m.
The public will call on the Consulate between 9 a.m. and 10 a.m.
Local Japanese residents will observe the National Foundation
Festival on February 11. In connection with the festival, a
ceremony will be held in the site of the Shanghai Shrine, Kiangwan
Road, at 11 a.m. under the auspices of various Japanese public
bodies. A large number of Japanese residents including high
officials are expected to attend. The programme of the ceremony
is as follows:-
1. Religious ceremony.
2. Hoisting a Rising Sun Flag.
3. Message or congratulation to be read by Mr. Amano, the
President of the Japanese Residents Corporation.
4. Singing of the National Foundation Song.
5. Cheers of three "Banzai".
The function will last about one hour.
In connection with the ceremony to be held in the compound
of the shrine, representatives of the Japanese Residents
Corporation, Japanese Consular Police, Japanese Naval Landing
Party, Japanese Military Police and Japanese Company of S.V.C.
gathered at the Japanese Club at 2 p.m. Feb. 6 to consider
precautionary measures and decided as follows:
1. Precautionary measures will be adopted from 10 a.m.

（左侧手写批注：C.P.H. / D.C.Ding / -8 FEB）

报告
日期：1937年2月8日。

主题：日本居民将于2月11日在江湾路上海神社举行的仪式。

制作人：D.S. Kamashita 转呈人：Ibayu D.S.I

神武天皇即位2,597周年纪念日将于2月11日到来，当天由日本居留民团、日本海军和日本总领事馆分别维持的本地日本学校将在上午举行祝贺陛下仪式。在日本领事馆，领事馆成员将于上午8时至9时举行仪式。公众将于上午9时至10时拜访领事馆。
本地日本居民将于2月11日庆祝建国节。结合该节日，在各日本公共团体的主办下，将于上午11时在江湾路上海神社旧址举行仪式。预计包括高级官员在内的大量日本居民将出席。仪式程序如下：
1. 宗教仪式。
2. 升起旭日旗。
3. 由日本居留民团团长天野（Amano）先生宣读贺词或祝辞。
4. 合唱建国歌。
5. 高呼三声“万岁”。
活动将持续约一小时。
针对将在神社院内举行的仪式，日本居留民团代表、日本领事警察、日本海军陆战队、日本宪兵队和上海万国商团（S.V.C.）日本连的代表于2月6日下午2时在日本俱乐部集会，商讨预防措施，并决定如下：
1. 预防措施将于上午10时开始实施。

（左侧手写批注：C.P.H. / D.C.Ding / -2月8日）
